plain.li: {X_nameDef} showed me a trick with onions I'd never seen. Years at the stove, and I felt like a child holding the spoon wrong.
Traded recipes with {X_nameDef}. I gave up my pemmican secret and got a stew in return. I'll be making it until somebody begs me to stop.
[winter] {X_nameDef} says where {X_pronoun} comes from they bury cabbages in the snow and dig them up sour in spring. I'm trying it. Nobody touch the snow by the kitchen.
[trait:Gourmand] {X_nameDef} let me taste a sauce made from things I'd have thrown away. I'm still thinking about it. I'll be thinking about it at my funeral.
[lowmood] Rotten week. Then {X_nameDef} showed me how to fry bread in a hot pan with a little fat, and for ten minutes the world was all right.
Spent the afternoon arguing with {X_nameDef} about salt. We both won. The stew lost.
[rain] Rained all day, so {X_nameDef} and I stayed in the kitchen and cooked everything in it. The colony ate well. The larder is weeping.

warm.li: {X_nameDef} wouldn't leave the kitchen until I'd folded the dumplings right three times. I hope someone on the road feeds {X_objective} as well as {X_pronoun} fed me today.
I gave {X_nameDef} a bag of my flatbread for the road. It felt right to send a bit of this place along.

blunt.li: {X_nameDef}'s recipe is better than mine. I'm writing that once, here, where nobody will read it.
Told {X_nameDef} the soup was bland. Then I stole the recipe. Both things are true.

cheerful.li: NEW RECIPE! From {X_nameDef}! It has honey AND meat in it and I don't care what anyone says!
[summer] {X_nameDef} showed me how to cook berries down so they keep! Jars of summer! I'm going to make a hundred!

gloomy.li: {X_nameDef} taught me {X_possessive} grandmother's stew. The grandmother died in a famine, {X_nameDef} said. That explains why it uses so little meat.
[winter] Learned a new dish from {X_nameDef}. It's mostly roots and patience. Good, because roots and patience are what we've got.

cold.li: {X_nameDef} gave me a way to cure meat that will stretch our stores by a week. Worth more than anything the caravan was selling.
{X_nameDef} talked while cooking. I listened. Recipes are cheaper to steal than to buy.

plain.li: {X_nameDef} is my best friend. {X_nameDef} is leaving with the caravan. I don't think that's fair, and I said so, loudly.
Me and {X_nameDef} found a dead beetle as big as my hand. We buried it with honors. {X_nameDef} did the speech.
[rain] It rained all day so {X_nameDef} and I made a fort out of blankets. Somebody wanted the blankets back. We said no.
[winter] {X_nameDef} and I had a snowball war. I won. {X_nameDef} says {X_pronoun} won. I'm writing it down so it's official: I won.
[newcomer] I'm new here and {X_nameDef} is new everywhere, all the time. We agreed to be new together.
{X_nameDef} knows a song about a goat with a terrible secret. I know it now too. The grown-ups don't like it.
[summer] {X_nameDef} and I sat in the stream until our toes went wrinkly. {X_nameDef} wants to be a trader when {X_pronoun} grows up. I want to be a bear.

warm.li: I gave {X_nameDef} my second-best rock so {X_pronoun} won't forget me on the road. It's a very good rock.
{X_nameDef} was scared of our big animals, so I held {X_possessive} hand past the pens. I was a bit scared too, but I didn't say.

blunt.li: {X_nameDef} cheats at tag. I let {X_objective} anyway. Only because {X_pronoun}'s a guest.
{X_nameDef} said our colony smells. It does. I still pushed {X_objective} in the mud.

cheerful.li: {X_nameDef} can whistle with TWO fingers! I can almost do it with one! We practiced all day!
We made a secret club, me and {X_nameDef}! It has two members and a password! I'm not allowed to write the password!

gloomy.li: {X_nameDef} told me about the place {X_pronoun} lived before. It got burned. {X_nameDef} said it like it was nothing. I don't think it was nothing.
[afterraid] {X_nameDef} asked if raiders come here a lot. I said only sometimes. I don't think {X_pronoun} believed me.

cold.li: {X_nameDef} is useful. {X_nameDef} knows where the caravan keeps the sweets.
I let {X_nameDef} win at stones so {X_pronoun} would like me. It worked. People are easy.

plain.li: {X_nameDef} laughed at my joke about the boomalope. Nobody laughs at that one. I might be in trouble.
Sat on the wall with {X_nameDef} until the stars came out. We talked about nothing. I keep thinking about it anyway.
[night] {X_nameDef} is asleep with the caravan by now. I am not asleep. I am writing this. That's all I'm going to say.
[trait:Abrasive] {X_nameDef} called me rude and then sat closer. I don't understand people, and for once I don't need to.
[spring] Spring, and a stranger with a nice laugh. I know exactly how this ends: with a caravan leaving. Still.
{X_nameDef} touched my arm when {X_pronoun} laughed. Twice. I counted.
[trait:Ugly] {X_nameDef} looked right at my face and smiled. I checked behind me. Nobody there.

warm.li: I hope {X_nameDef} gets wherever {X_pronoun}'s going safely. I hope the road brings {X_objective} back this way.
{X_nameDef} asked about my scar and actually listened to the answer. I'd forgotten what that feels like.

blunt.li: Flirted with a visitor. It went fine. Shut up.
{X_nameDef} has nice hands and terrible jokes. I'd put up with the jokes.

cheerful.li: {X_nameDef} SMILED at me! On purpose! I checked!
I told {X_nameDef} {X_pronoun} had eyes like a sunset, and {X_nameDef} said "red?" and we laughed for ten minutes! Best day!

gloomy.li: {X_nameDef} will leave with the caravan, and I'll still be here mucking out the same pens. Nice while it lasted. It's still lasting, technically.
[lowmood] For one evening {X_nameDef} made me forget this place. Then the evening ended.

cold.li: {X_nameDef} was charming. I was more charming. A pleasant way to spend an evening, and it cost nothing.
{X_nameDef} is attractive and leaves soon. The ideal arrangement.

plain.li: {X_nameDef} knew my name before I said it. Apparently they talk about me on the road. I don't know whether to be proud or start sleeping with a knife.
There's a story going around about me. {X_nameDef} told it. I was taller in it, and I killed more people. I'll take it.
[afterraid] We'd barely washed the blood off when {X_nameDef} asked if I was the one from the stories. After this week, maybe I am.
[trait:Wimp] {X_nameDef} says I'm famous for my bravery. I fainted at a splinter last month. Somebody out there is lying, and I won't be correcting them.
[old] {X_nameDef}'s father used to tell stories about me, {X_nameDef} said. The father. I'm going to go lie down.
[newcomer] I've barely been here a season and the road already has a song about me. Three verses. Two of them rhyme.
{X_nameDef} wanted to shake my hand. Then {X_nameDef} wanted to shake it again, for a friend who couldn't come.

warm.li: {X_nameDef} said the stories about me give people hope out there. I don't feel like a hope. I'll try to be one.
I hope whatever {X_nameDef} heard about me was the kind part.

blunt.li: Apparently I'm famous. Doesn't make the latrine dig itself.
{X_nameDef} got half the story wrong. I left it wrong. The wrong version's better.

cheerful.li: I'm in a SONG! {X_nameDef} sang it! I come in at the second verse and fight a bear! I have never fought a bear! I'd like to!
Someone on the road knows who I am! I waved at {X_nameDef} all day like a lunatic!

gloomy.li: If they know my name out there, so do the raiders. Thanks, {X_nameDef}.
{X_nameDef} told me the story they tell about me. Everyone in it dies except me. That part's true.

cold.li: A reputation is a weapon nobody can take off you. {X_nameDef} says mine is sharp. Good.
{X_nameDef} recognized me. I'd like to know who else does, and what exactly they're saying.

plain.li: {X_nameDef} had better scars than me. I had better stories. We called it even.
{X_nameDef} fought in the same kind of war I did, probably on the other side. Didn't matter tonight.
[afterraid] Told {X_nameDef} about the last fight while it was still fresh. {X_nameDef} listened like a soldier: no questions until the end, and then the right one.
[trait:Bloodlust] {X_nameDef} has killed more people than I have. I'm jealous, and also a little bit in love.
[hurt] Showed {X_nameDef} the new wound. {X_nameDef} said it'll heal ugly, and that ugly is the best kind. I'll hold {X_objective} to that.
{X_nameDef} showed me a better way to hold a spear when they come at you in a line. I hope I never need it. I'm practicing anyway.
[winter] Cold night, good fire, and a stranger who knows exactly what I mean when I say I still hear it sometimes.

warm.li: We drank to everyone we've lost, {X_nameDef} and me. It took a while. Neither of us rushed it.
I told {X_nameDef} I hope {X_pronoun} never has to fight again. {X_nameDef} said the same about me. Neither of us believed it.

blunt.li: {X_nameDef} can fight. Respect. That's all.
{X_nameDef} says {X_possessive} old company would've held our wall better. Well, they aren't here, are they.

cheerful.li: {X_nameDef} and I acted out a whole battle with spoons and a turnip! The turnip was the enemy! The turnip lost!
Best war stories ever! {X_nameDef} once fought a man with a ladder! I want a ladder!

gloomy.li: {X_nameDef} has the same look I have, the one where you're always counting the exits. Takes one to know one.
We told stories until the fire went out. All of {X_nameDef}'s end with somebody dead. Mine too.

cold.li: {X_nameDef} had useful observations on flanking. I'll test them on the next raid.
{X_nameDef} says raiders break when the one in front goes down. Simple. I'll make sure the one in front goes down first.

plain.li: {X_nameDef} talked about a warm sea and fish that jump into the boats. I looked at our fields for a long time afterwards.
[winter] Somewhere south it's warm right now. {X_nameDef} has been there. I have frostbite on one ear.
[spring] The roads are open again. {X_nameDef} will be on one soon. I'll be here, with the turnips.
{X_nameDef} has seen a city with a thousand chimneys. I keep thinking about the chimneys. Who sweeps them all?
[trait:Undergrounder] {X_nameDef} talked about plains so wide you can see weather coming for three days. Sounds horrible. Glad I'm here, under a good roof.
[small] There are so few of us here, and {X_nameDef} talked about markets with crowds you can get lost in. I'd like to get lost. Just for an afternoon.
I asked {X_nameDef} what's past the mountains. More mountains, {X_nameDef} said, then the sea. I'm going to dream about the sea.

warm.li: Maybe someday we'll all go and see {X_nameDef}'s warm coast together. The whole colony, on a beach. I'd like that.
I asked {X_nameDef} to look at the sea for me when {X_pronoun} gets there.

blunt.li: Trader talks too much about places I'll never see. Bought a needle anyway.
Warm sea. Jumping fish. Either {X_nameDef} is lying, or I'm going.

cheerful.li: There's a desert where the sand SINGS! {X_nameDef} heard it! I'm going someday! I've already packed a sock!
I'm making a list of everywhere {X_nameDef} has been! It's very long! I've been to one of them! It's here!

gloomy.li: {X_nameDef} told me about places I'll never see. Then {X_nameDef} left to go and see them.
[lowmood] Somewhere out there people are eating fresh fish by a warm sea. Here we're eating whatever the rats left.

cold.li: {X_nameDef}'s descriptions of the southern routes were detailed. Useful, if we ever need to leave in a hurry.
The world is larger than this valley. I'll keep that in mind as an option.

plain.li: {X_nameDef} sold me watered beer and a smile. The smile was watered too.
Counted the coins {X_nameDef} gave me three times. Came up short three times. {X_nameDef} was very busy with someone else by the third.
[trait:Greedy] I have been robbed. By a professional. I'm furious, and also taking notes.
[trait:TooSmart] I should have checked the scales. I always check the scales. I didn't check the scales.
The boots {X_nameDef} sold me lasted a day. My grudge will last longer.
[rain] It's raining, and my new cloak from {X_nameDef} lets every drop straight through. "Weatherproof," {X_nameDef} said. Weatherproof.
[hurt] Hobbled over to complain to {X_nameDef} about the bandages. They're bandages the way a sieve is a bucket.

warm.li: Maybe {X_nameDef} needed the silver more than I did. I'm trying to believe that. It isn't going well.
I wanted to think the best of {X_nameDef}. I'll think the best of the next one, and check the scales.

blunt.li: {X_nameDef} is a thief with a cart. If {X_pronoun} comes back, I'm doing the weighing.
Cheated. Me. By THAT.

cheerful.li: Got swindled! Lesson learned! The lesson is never buy a "lucky" anything!
{X_nameDef} sold me a rock and called it a whetstone! It's a nice rock though! I'm keeping it!

gloomy.li: Raiders, wolves, plague, and still the trader finds a way to rob you. Some things are eternal.
Of course {X_nameDef} cheated me. Why would today be any different.

cold.li: {X_nameDef} misjudged who to cheat. I've written down the caravan's route and its faction.
Cost: a few silver. Lesson: {X_nameDef}'s word is worth nothing. Cheap at the price.

plain.li: {X_nameDef} wanted the bed turned to face east. Then west. Then wanted to know why it's so small. It's a bed.
Carried hot water for {X_nameDef} four times today. The water was the wrong temperature four times.
[trait:Ascetic] {X_nameDef} asked how anyone can live like this. I sleep on a plank and I've never been happier. I didn't say so.
[trait:Abrasive] {X_nameDef} called me a servant. I called {X_nameDef} something too. We are both waiting to see who apologizes first.
[small] There's only a handful of us, and {X_nameDef} expects a staff. Today I was the cook, the maid and the guard, and it wasn't even noon.
{X_nameDef} snaps {X_possessive} fingers for service. I've started going deaf at convenient moments.
[rich] We have more than most colonies on this whole continent, and {X_nameDef} still asked whether we're "getting by".

warm.li: {X_nameDef} is rude, but scared, I think. People far from home get rude. I brought the tea anyway.
Under all the demands, {X_nameDef} said thank you once. Very quietly. I'm going to remember the once.

blunt.li: Nobles. One more day of {X_nameDef} and I'm putting a lizard in the pillow.
{X_nameDef} wanted to know if I'd been "trained". I have. With an axe.

cheerful.li: {X_nameDef} said my manners were "nearly adequate"! NEARLY! I'll get there!
I've learned seven ways {X_nameDef} doesn't like eggs! Tomorrow I'm trying an eighth!

gloomy.li: {X_nameDef} looks at all of us like we're stains. Maybe we are. Out here everything's a stain eventually.
We risk our necks to keep {X_nameDef} safe, and {X_nameDef} complains about the pillows. That's how it's always been, I suppose.

cold.li: {X_nameDef} is unpleasant but well connected. I smile. The smile is an investment.
I've noted everything {X_nameDef} demanded today. When the reward comes, it had better cover it.

plain.li: {X_nameDef} cried into the stew I brought. Didn't say why. Didn't need to.
{X_nameDef} sleeps with {X_possessive} shoes on, ready to run. Last night {X_nameDef} took them off. I noticed.
[winter] Gave {X_nameDef} my spare blanket. It's cold enough that I'll regret it tonight. I don't regret it.
[trait:Kind] {X_nameDef} thanked me for a bowl of stew like I'd handed over a kingdom. I didn't know what to do with my hands.
[grieving] I've lost someone too. I didn't tell {X_nameDef}. I just sat with {X_objective} a while, and maybe that said it.
{X_nameDef} carved me a little bird. It looks like a potato with a beak. It's on my shelf, front and center.
[afterraid] After this week I know a little of what {X_nameDef} ran from. I'm glad there's a wall between us and them, for now.

warm.li: {X_nameDef} has eaten properly two days in a row. That's the best thing I've done all season.
I told {X_nameDef} {X_pronoun}'s safe here. I'll make it true if I have to.

blunt.li: {X_nameDef} keeps thanking me. Stop thanking me. Eat.
Whoever {X_nameDef} is running from can try the gate. I'll be standing behind it.

cheerful.li: {X_nameDef} smiled today! First time! I'm counting it as a victory for the whole colony!
I taught {X_nameDef} our silly dinner song and {X_nameDef} actually sang along! Badly! Wonderful!

gloomy.li: {X_nameDef} said thank you like someone who's had very little to thank anyone for. I know that voice. I used to have it.
We give {X_nameDef} stew and a bed. Whatever chased {X_objective} here is still out there, walking around. Stew doesn't fix that.

cold.li: {X_nameDef} is grateful. Gratitude is a debt. I haven't decided yet what I'll collect.
{X_nameDef} told me everything about the people chasing {X_objective}. Numbers, weapons, names. Very useful.

plain.li: {X_nameDef} told me how {X_pronoun} ended up raiding. I keep thinking about the part with the cousin.
Sat outside {X_nameDef}'s door longer than I meant to. It's strange, liking someone through a lock.
[night] Can't sleep. {X_nameDef}'s story is still going round my head, the bit about the burnt crust.
[trait:Kind] Nobody's born a raider. {X_nameDef} wasn't. I'd like to think {X_pronoun} doesn't have to die one.
[afterraid] Hard to listen to {X_nameDef}'s story the same week {X_possessive} kind came over our wall. I listened anyway. I'm not sure what that makes me.
{X_nameDef} misses {X_possessive} mother's cooking more than freedom. Said so. Then asked what was for dinner.
[rain] Rain on the prison roof. {X_nameDef} said it sounds like home. I didn't ask where home was. I should have.

warm.li: I want {X_nameDef} to have a second chance. I want us to be the kind of place that gives them.
{X_nameDef} said nobody had asked about {X_possessive} life in years. So I asked. It took all evening.

blunt.li: {X_nameDef}'s got a sad story. Everyone's got a sad story. {X_nameDef}'s was better than most.
Still a raider. Still locked up. Still kind of liked talking to {X_objective}.

cheerful.li: {X_nameDef} told me a story through the door and it was really good! I think we're friends now! Through a door!
{X_nameDef} does voices! Even locked up! I laughed so hard the warden glared at me!

gloomy.li: {X_nameDef} could have been me, with a worse year. Most raiders could. That's the bit I can't put down.
A sad story, a cell and a cold bowl. That's {X_nameDef}'s whole life right now. Could be anyone's.

cold.li: {X_nameDef} talks freely now. Every story is another lever. I'm keeping them all.
{X_nameDef} believes I'm sympathetic. Good. That makes recruitment simpler.

plain.li: {X_nameDef} knew the work song. Same mines, different years. I didn't expect to hear it again in this life.
Turns out {X_nameDef} and I grew up two valleys apart. Same bad bread, same tax collector, probably. Small world, and one of us is in a cell.
[old] {X_nameDef} remembers the old ways too. Hardly anyone does anymore. We talked about them like dead friends.
[winter] {X_nameDef} remembers the winter the river froze solid back home. So do I. We were both there, it turns out, on different banks.
[trait:Abrasive] I don't like most people. {X_nameDef} grew up as rough as I did, and I don't hate {X_objective}. That's a lot, from me.
[night] I can hear {X_nameDef} humming the old songs in the cell. I hum back. The others think we're mad.
{X_nameDef} and I both ran away at twelve. I ran here. {X_nameDef} ran into the wrong crowd. A coin toss, really.

warm.li: It's been a long time since anyone knew where I came from without being told. {X_nameDef} does. I'd forgotten how much I missed that.
I'm going to ask the council to give {X_nameDef} a chance. People like us don't get many.

blunt.li: {X_nameDef} is from where I'm from. That doesn't make {X_objective} a friend. It makes {X_objective} close.
Same past. Different choices. I'm still the one with the keys.

cheerful.li: {X_nameDef} knows the clapping game from my village! THE CLAPPING GAME! We did it through the bars!
I found someone who swears in my old dialect! We swore at each other for an hour! It was wonderful!

gloomy.li: {X_nameDef} and I came out of the same mud. One of us got lucky. I'm not sure it was me.
Everyone from back home is dead or a raider, it turns out. {X_nameDef} is nearly both.

cold.li: Shared history makes {X_nameDef} easy to read. I know what {X_pronoun} fears, because I used to fear it.
{X_nameDef} trusts me now, because of where we're from. I'll use that, for the colony's sake and maybe {X_possessive}.

plain.li: {X_nameDef} is behind a door I can lock. I walked past it four times today to make sure it holds.
Looked {X_nameDef} in the eye today. My hands didn't shake until afterwards.
[hurt] Still healing from what {X_nameDef} did. {X_nameDef} asked how it was healing. I didn't answer. I'm still not answering.
[trait:Bloodlust] {X_nameDef} is right there, unarmed, behind one little door. The council had better have a plan. I have several.
[trait:Kind] I hate {X_nameDef}. I brought {X_objective} water anyway. I'm not sure who that was for.
[night] Dreamed {X_nameDef} got out. Went and checked. Still there, asleep. How can {X_nameDef} sleep?
{X_nameDef} looked away first. I've been waiting a long time for that.

warm.li: I want to be bigger than what {X_nameDef} did to me. Today I wasn't. Maybe tomorrow.
Everyone keeps asking if I'm all right since {X_nameDef} was brought in. I'm all right. I will be.

blunt.li: {X_nameDef}'s in a cell. I'm not. That's the whole entry.
Told {X_nameDef} I'd be the last face {X_pronoun} ever sees. Probably shouldn't have. Meant it.

cheerful.li: Guess who's eating cold porridge behind bars tonight? Not me! I'm having stew!
I sang outside {X_nameDef}'s door! Loudly! Every song I know! Nobody stopped me!

gloomy.li: {X_nameDef} is caught, and I still wake up on the ground in that fight. Locks don't reach that far.
I thought it would feel like winning, seeing {X_nameDef} locked up. It feels like a scar that itches.

cold.li: {X_nameDef} is contained. I've begun thinking about what comes after, in detail.
{X_nameDef} remembers me. Good. It's important that {X_pronoun} does.

plain.li: {X_nameDef} was lying in the mud asking for water. I gave it. I don't know what that makes me, but I know what the other choice would have made me.
[hurt] I was bleeding too, a little, when I held the cup for {X_nameDef}. Two leaking people in the mud, and neither of us mentioned whose fault it was.
[rain] {X_nameDef} was lying face up in the rain, trying to drink it. I rolled {X_objective} onto {X_possessive} side so {X_pronoun} wouldn't drown, then fetched a proper cup.
[trait:Kind] {X_nameDef} came here to kill us. I gave {X_objective} water anyway. I'd do it again. I hate that I'd do it again.
[winter] The water in my skin was half ice. {X_nameDef} drank it anyway, and thanked me with blue lips.
[night] Can't sleep. I keep seeing {X_nameDef}'s hands shaking around the cup.
{X_nameDef} said a lot of things while drinking. The worst was "thank you".

warm.li: {X_nameDef} was somebody's child once. I tried to remember that while I held the cup.
I hope someone did the same for our people, on the days we lost. I hope someone held the cup.

blunt.li: Gave a raider water. Don't make it a thing.
{X_nameDef} drank half and spilled the other half down my sleeve. Ungrateful, and wet.

cheerful.li: {X_nameDef} said I had a kind face, from the mud! Nobody's ever said that! Not even from the mud!
I gave {X_nameDef} a drink and {X_nameDef} said I make good water! It's just water! But thank you!

gloomy.li: One day it'll be me in the mud, asking a stranger for water. I hope the stranger is like me today, and not like me most days.
Gave {X_nameDef} water so {X_pronoun} could hurt a little longer. Mercy is a funny word out here.

cold.li: {X_nameDef} offered information for water. A fair trade. I took notes.
A grateful enemy is more useful than a dead one. I gave {X_nameDef} water accordingly.

plain.li: Somebody's words are in my head now, handed to me by {X_nameDef} in the dirt. I'll carry them. I don't know where to.
I promised {X_nameDef} I'd pass the message on. It's not a promise I know how to keep. It's still a promise.
[hurt] I was bleeding too, a little, when {X_nameDef} grabbed my sleeve. Two leaking people in the mud, and only one of us thought it was the end.
[rain] {X_nameDef} whispered it in the rain, and I had to lean right down to hear. My knees are still wet. The words are still there.
[trait:Kind] {X_nameDef} came here to kill us, and I knelt in the dirt and promised to remember. I meant it. I hate that I meant it.
[night] Can't sleep. I keep hearing {X_nameDef} asking me to remember, and I'm remembering.
{X_nameDef} thought those were the last words. Maybe they weren't. I've got them now either way.

warm.li: {X_nameDef} was somebody's child once, and somebody is still waiting. I hope the message finds them.
I'll ask every caravan that comes through. Someone out there should hear what {X_nameDef} said.

blunt.li: A raider gave me a message. I'm not a messenger. I'll probably pass it on anyway.
{X_nameDef} talked my ear off while bleeding. Some people don't know how to lie still.

cheerful.li: I'm keeping {X_nameDef}'s message safe in my boot! It's the safest place I have! Mostly safe!
{X_nameDef} said I had an honest face, from the mud! I'm going to be honest about it! I'll pass it on!

gloomy.li: {X_nameDef} asked me to tell somebody something. Everyone out here is carrying messages for the dead, or the nearly dead.
One day it'll be me in the dirt, handing my last words to a stranger. I hope they're better words than mine would be today.

cold.li: {X_nameDef} talked freely from the ground. Names, places, who's waiting for {X_objective}. I took it all down.
Last words are surprisingly informative. {X_nameDef} gave me a name and a place. Filed.
